page_title: RBL 3-1 FRE | RB Leipzig v Freiburg 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Patrick Ittrich is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
90+2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from RB Leipzig.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Christian Streich decides to make a substitution. Lucas Holer will be replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
88' The substitution is prepared. Kenneth Schmidt (Freiburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Manuel Gulde.
86' That's the end of the game for Xavi Simons, who is replaced by Christopher Lenz (RB Leipzig).
85' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
84' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Freiburg.
83' The game is interrupted. David Raum (RB Leipzig) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

80' 3 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Noah Atubolu. He makes it 3:1.
79' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Vincenzo Grifo and he is replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg).
79' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Merlin Rohl.
79' 2 - 1 Goal! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Noah Atubolu.
79' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
78' The RB Leipzig players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
77' Referee Patrick Ittrich makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for RB Leipzig. Let’s see what happens!
77' PENALTY APPEAL after Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
76' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
74' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
74' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
73' The attendance for today's match is 45000.
72' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. RB Leipzig have been awarded a free kick.
70' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) is penalised for a foul. Patrick Ittrich had a clear view and blows his whistle.
68' Substitution. Amadou Haidara did his best and is replaced by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:4.
65' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
63' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) was probably a bit loose with his words to Patrick Ittrich, who decides to show him a yellow.
63' It is time for a substitution. Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) is on for Benjamin Sesko.
63' Here is a change. Emil Forsberg is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed Simakan departs the field of play to be replaced by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig).
62' The game is interrupted. Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
60' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
59' The corner from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is cleared away by the defence.
58' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) serves up a nice cross, but Janis Blaswich punches the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
57' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
55' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu makes a comfortable save.
53' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) has a goal ruled out for offside!
52' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Janis Blaswich intercepts the ball.
51' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) attempts to find Lois Openda, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
49' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' Patrick Ittrich blows for a foul after Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

47' The linesman signals that Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is offside and the referee confirms the decision. The ball falls kindly for Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the right post.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+6' 1 - 1 Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Janis Blaswich is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
45+6' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) is able to continue to play.
45+5' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
45+5' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes it short.
45+3' The game is interrupted now, Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

45+3' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+1' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) tries to find Lois Openda, but he puts too much power on the pass.
42' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
41' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but Janis Blaswich comes off his line to gather the ball.

40' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) climbs high to connect with a cross heading towards the edge of the box and produces a poor header which goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
39' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Freiburg will have a throw-in.
37' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
35' A goal, which was scored by Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg), was disallowed due to offside.
34' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

32' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
31' The players claim that Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Freiburg are awarded the free kick.
29' RB Leipzig players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence. 68:32 – the ratio of ball possession.
27' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
26' David Raum (RB Leipzig) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.
25' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Noah Atubolu, who smothers the ball.
24' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner which is cleared.

24' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Noah Atubolu easily deals with the threat. RB Leipzig force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
22' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

21' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
18' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

18' Xavi Simons whips in the corner and finds Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) in space with just the keeper to beat, but somehow he plants his header just past the right post from close in. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
17' The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig win a corner kick.

17' Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig win a corner kick.
15' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
12' David Raum (RB Leipzig) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
11' The ball is cleared after Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. RB Leipzig can continue in their attacking effort.
11' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is caught offside!
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig).
7' The foul by Lucas Holer (Freiburg) was seen by Patrick Ittrich who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
6' 1 - 0 GOAL! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
5' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
4' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
3' The referee points to the corner flag and RB Leipzig will take a corner.
3' A cross from Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and RB Leipzig will take a corner.
2' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! RB Leipzig will take the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich will supervise the game today.
